# id: PG-pg-89-balance-perception
# covers: PG 199 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Beaks + Avarek)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 36D7474D+ (pg_statprobe), harness 5AF3E517+ (44992a0: teleport moved=) (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: a neutral observer (Hungry Bandit, Drifters, renamed PGWatch) stands 20 m from Avarek, who sneaks
#   (detecttime: sneak on, the observer's earlier sighting reset). Result = game seconds until seen
#   (timeout 120 s). The observer's skill/gear varies (perception).
#   Both are put back to their places before every point; the observer is killed at the end.
# verify: seen=1 in most points (seen=0 everywhere: this observer never notices a sneaker, send the .out to
#   the PG agent); stealth: seconds_to_seen grows with Stealth; perception: it shrinks with Perception.
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
wake Avarek
speed 1
@sleep 4
speed 0
protect Beaks on
protect Avarek on
hunger Avarek 280
hunger Beaks 280
select Avarek
clearjobs Avarek
pg_statprobe on Avarek
wake Avarek
speed 1
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 60 ~ moved=1
setstat Avarek stealth 30
@set OBS spawn "Hungry Bandit" Drifters near Avarek dist 20 count 1 ~ spawned 1/1 [^:]+: .+? (#\d+(?:/\d+)?)
setname ${OBS} PGWatch
relation PGWatch 0
setstat PGWatch perception 30
where PGWatch
pg_statprobe on PGWatch
give PGWatch "Iron Hat" 1
equip PGWatch "Iron Hat"
pg_info PGWatch "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
# --- w1: perception 10, gear none ---
setstat PGWatch perception 10
pg_clear PGWatch ~ cleared affixes
stealth Avarek off
wake Avarek
speed 1
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 60 ~ moved=1
@until 30 teleport PGWatch Avarek dist 20 ~ moved=1
speed 1
@sleep 3
@set T detecttime Avarek PGWatch timeout 120 ~ (seen=\d seconds_to_seen=\S+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,199,perception,10,0,none,w1,detect_observer,120,${T},-
pg_statprobe read
# --- w2: perception 90, gear none ---
setstat PGWatch perception 90
pg_clear PGWatch ~ cleared affixes
stealth Avarek off
wake Avarek
speed 1
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 60 ~ moved=1
@until 30 teleport PGWatch Avarek dist 20 ~ moved=1
speed 1
@sleep 3
@set T detecttime Avarek PGWatch timeout 120 ~ (seen=\d seconds_to_seen=\S+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,199,perception,90,0,none,w2,detect_observer,120,${T},-
pg_statprobe read
# --- w3: perception 50, gear none ---
setstat PGWatch perception 50
pg_clear PGWatch ~ cleared affixes
stealth Avarek off
wake Avarek
speed 1
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 60 ~ moved=1
@until 30 teleport PGWatch Avarek dist 20 ~ moved=1
speed 1
@sleep 3
@set T detecttime Avarek PGWatch timeout 120 ~ (seen=\d seconds_to_seen=\S+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,199,perception,50,0,none,w3,detect_observer,120,${T},-
pg_statprobe read
# --- w4: perception 50, gear own25 ---
setstat PGWatch perception 50
pg_clear PGWatch ~ cleared affixes
pg_force_affix PGWatch "Iron Hat" perception 25 tier 6 ~ affixes=
pg_bonus PGWatch perception ~ equipped_bonus=25% .*match=1
pg_statprobe read
stealth Avarek off
wake Avarek
speed 1
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Avarek Beaks dist 60 ~ moved=1
@until 30 teleport PGWatch Avarek dist 20 ~ moved=1
speed 1
@sleep 3
@set T detecttime Avarek PGWatch timeout 120 ~ (seen=\d seconds_to_seen=\S+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,199,perception,50,25,own25,w4,detect_observer,120,${T},-
pg_statprobe read

pg_statprobe read
stealth Avarek off
